suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Trial lesson
suggested_services.example: The main story: Noah's $20 trial lesson in Grace's Preschool 1, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, paid in full when booking. A single lesson ($28), a private lesson ($65) and each month of a monthly session ($112 for 4 weekly lessons, billed on the 1st with a text the day before) are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the price may be kept, only with Sam's OK. A missed monthly lesson gets a make-up with notice. Thunder or a pool closure: a free make-up or a refund.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson at your pool
suggested_services.example: The main story: Sofia's $75 private lesson at the family's pool with Marcus, Thu Oct 22 at 4:30pm, paid in full when booking. A $150 group lesson at a host pool and a pool party lifeguard ($120) are paid this way too. Late or nobody at the pool: the $75 may be kept, only with Sam's OK. Thunder or an unsafe pool: a free make-up or a refund.

before_times: who is swimming: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the lesson group)
comfort in water: puts their face in? floats? swims a few strokes alone? (it sets the level)
for a private lesson: at the school's pool or the family's own pool, and the goal
for a lesson at home: is the pool fenced, with a gate that latches?
after_time: is the child potty-trained? (if not, a swim diaper is needed)
is anything about water scary for the swimmer, or anything the instructor should know?
for a lesson at home: the address, and the way to the pool gate
secure_page_only: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, health notes (like ear tubes, seizures or asthma) and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in the lesson
adults: their own waiver; Parent and Tot: the parent's own line too
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: a child who was in the water and is now coughing hard, struggling to breathe or very sleepy; someone hurt or unwell right now

go_on.words: a health note, like ear tubes or asthma
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the instructor; Rosie gives no health advice
Sam reads the note on the secure page before it's booked: often a private lesson, with the instructor within arm's reach

go_on.words: a child who is scared of water
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the instructor, who goes slowly; a scared child is never forced

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first lesson, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own; in Parent and Tot, the parent also signs a line for themselves
steps.goodFor: 1 year, or until the school changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement
steps.when: the trial places the child; a level above level 1 is asked about before booking
steps.result: Sam OKs a level above level 1 first

steps.name: A seizure history
steps.when: when the secure page shows one
steps.result: Sam reads the note before it's booked; often a private lesson, the instructor within arm's reach

steps.name: The home pool check
steps.when: for a lesson at home, on the secure page while booking, and again when the instructor arrives
steps.result: the pool is fenced with a latching gate, the water is clear to the bottom, and a parent stays at the edge; if not, no lesson, and a make-up or a refund

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; a swimsuit, a towel, and goggles if the child has them; a swim diaper (a disposable one under a reusable cover) for a child who isn't potty-trained; a parent stays on the deck; for a lesson at home, the gate unlocked and the pool cover off

staff.skills: group lessons by level, Parent and Tot, private lessons, adult beginners, swimmers with extra needs, lifeguarding
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor in the water holds a current water safety instructor certificate and a CPR and first aid certificate; a lifeguard holds a current lifeguard certificate (switches from the state's form, on by default)
staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults on the deck for group lessons (the school's setting)
staff.who_oks: Sam places swimmers above level 1, reads seizure notes and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
staff.ratio: 4 swimmers per instructor in Preschool, 5 in Swim Kids, 6 parent-and-child pairs in Parent and Tot (the school's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first

visit.check_in: at the school: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the front desk, or the instructor ticks names on the lesson roster; at a home pool: the code at the gate; at a host pool: the host's contact gives the code
visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; at a home pool, the code at the gate or DONE from the instructor
visit.changes_at_visit: an instructor change is texted to every parent booked; a level change after the trial goes in the instructor's note

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: from the state form: teaching swimming usually needs no state license; a pool used for lessons may need a health permit and inspections where the state's or county's rules require it (a switch); some places register a swim school or set rules for selling lessons ahead
license.who: the business, for any registration and the school's pool permit; each instructor and lifeguard, for their own certificates
license.ask: any business registration number; for the school's own pool, the pool permit number and its renewal date where the state's form asks; for each instructor, a current water safety instructor certificate and a CPR and first aid certificate; for each lifeguard, a current lifeguard certificate
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or where a host pool (a community center, an apartment building) asks for proof
license.background: a background check for each person who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form; the owner can also turn it on): who ran it and when, kept on file, renewed on the state's schedule

never_in_a_text: a child's last name, age, health notes (like ear tubes or seizures), skills note, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the lesson, and link to the secure page
